title: Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Analyse a class play and a solo song; visit a real or virtual gallery for critique. Anti-doping from news stories.

skills.key_step: The child analyses a play performance (theme, setting, conflict, resolution, voice, body, props, costume, audience) and a solo vocal piece (melody, dynamics, tempo, diction, message, accompaniment) with evidence.

floor.prerequisite: Analyses a verse and a folk dance (Grade 8).
floor.question: What is the message of a verse?
floor.answer: what it says about its topic

representations: a recording of a solo song
steps: Note what you see and hear.
contexts: a solo at a music festival

board.do: The singer whispers the last line.
Sadness or calm at the end.

misconceptions.ask: Which is an analysis of a play performance?
misconceptions.repair: Ask "what did you see or hear that shows that?"

misconceptions.ask: What is diction in a solo vocal piece?
misconceptions.repair: Sing a line mumbling and then clearly.

misconceptions.ask: Can a solo vocal piece have an accompaniment?
misconceptions.repair: Listen to a soloist with a guitar.

misconceptions.ask: Name one thing to look for when analysing a play performance.

checks.question: Name two things to analyse in a play performance.
checks.answer: any two of: theme, setting, conflict, resolution, voice, body, props, costume, audience

checks.question: What is diction?
checks.answer: how clearly the words are pronounced

skills.key_step: The child names ethical practices in sport (no doping, fair play, honest age, no match fixing, respect, safeguarding) and why doping is banned.
steps: Name the practice kept or broken.
contexts: an age-cheating case in school games

board.do: A player takes a drug to run faster.

misconceptions.ask: Is a small amount of a banned substance allowed?

listen_for: yes, it helps the team win
misconceptions.ask: Is it fair to lie about age to play in a younger team?
misconceptions.repair: Discuss how the younger players feel.

misconceptions.ask: A player is paid to lose a match on purpose. Is that ethical?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about fans, team mates and the sport.

misconceptions.ask: Give two reasons why doping is banned.
misconceptions.repair: Discuss what doping does to fairness.

checks.question: Why is doping banned?
checks.answer: it is cheating and harms health

checks.question: What is match fixing?
checks.answer: deciding a result on purpose, often for money

skills.key_step: The child critiques an artwork in four steps (describe, analyse, interpret, judge), kindly and with evidence.

floor.question: Name two details in a catalogue entry.
floor.answer: any two of: title, artist, medium, date

listen_for: say if it is good or bad
misconceptions.ask: What is the first step of a critique?
misconceptions.repair: Use the four steps: describe, analyse, interpret, judge.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a good critique judgement?

listen_for: whether the artist is a nice person
misconceptions.ask: What should a critique comment on?
misconceptions.repair: Cover the name and critique the work only.

listen_for: listing what is in the picture
misconceptions.ask: What is the interpretation step of a critique?
misconceptions.repair: Ask "what is the artist telling us?" after describing.

checks.question: What are the four steps of a critique?
